The difficulty coefficients of undergraduates in Grades 2012, 2013 and 2014 were 0.390, 0.275 and 0.210 respectively, showing a year by year decline. The ranks of test paper scores had a statistical difference among Grades 2012, 2013 and 2014 (H=82.831, P<;0.05), and there were statistical differences between every two grades (P<;0.05). Conclusion The case teaching method, combined with effective questioning, significantly amended the classroom atmosphere, enhanced students' understanding and mastery of Toxicology knowledge, increased the students' ability to analyze and solve problems, and effectively improved the teaching effect of “Toxicology”.

articleTitle: Visualization of Geographic Information Retrieval Results Supporting User Participation
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As the swift development of 3S (remote sensing, geography information system and global positioning system) technology and relevant information technologies, the demand for Geographic Information Retrieval has risen sharply. Based on user-centered principle and the problems in traditional geographic information retrieval results visualization, an improved scatter coordinate system was proposed. Firstly, the mapping relationship between the spatial entities and the coordinate point was established. Combining the spatial attributes and non-spatial attributes, the retrieval results were expressed graphically. Meanwhile, necessary interactive methods were provided to help users cognize and evaluate the results conveniently. Consequently, the objectives could be obtained more efficiently. Issues to be further studied and improved were discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Modeling of a New Sensorless Suction Detection System for the Rotary Left Ventricular Assist Device
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The rotary left ventricular assist device (LVAD) has been successfully and clinically used for congestive heart failure patients. However, patients may be at significant risk for ventricular suction while using a LVAD. Suction may lead to ventricular collapse when the blood pump of the LVAD is working at higher rotational speeds to draw more blood than available. Some suction detection systems typically required the external implantation of sensors, which were not reliable for long-term use because of failure, baseline drift, and short lifespan of sensors. In this study, a new sensorless suction detection system only using the intrinsic pump parameter (pump speed) to eliminate all external sensors is proposed. Three features (suction indicators) are extracted from the pump speed signals without and with measurement noise and adopted as inputs to different classifiers. Two pumping states as no suction or suction are classified with each classifier. The in-silico results with a combined human circulatory system and LVAD model show that the proposed strategy can detect ventricular suction effectively with high accuracy and stability. It could provide theoretical basis and technology support for developing the LVAD controller with high reliability.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Health and Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Pulse Diagnosis for the Elderly Using Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study used wearable devices and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) diagnosis, which verifies the promotion of wearable devices on the health habits of the elderly, and the correlation between pulse diagnosis and health. We used wearable devices and TCM diagnosis (including TCM doctor diagnosis and Pulse diagnosis instrument) to record health information for the elderly. One-way repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to determine health changes. Correlation analysis was used to determine the relationship between pulse and health indicators. There was significant change in the number of steps for the elderly before and after using the wearable device. Systolic blood pressure (SBP) was negatively correlated with pulse wave time. Diastolic blood pressure (DBP) was negatively correlated with pulse duration. Pulse diagnosis can be used as an indicator to report the health of the elderly. And used wearable devices can quantify health indicators and improve the health awareness.

Author Keywords: Wearable device, TCM, Chinese medicine diagnosis, the elderly, blood pressure

articleTitle: Preliminary Study of RT-LAMP Method for Detection of Ibaraki Virus
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To detect Ibaraki virus (IBAV) sensitively and quickly, a rapid detection technique of reverse transcriptase isothermal nucleic acid amplification (RT-LAMP) for the virus was established, through the main steps as follows: the design of 4 specific primers basing on the 6 conserved regions of IBAV VP3 protein gene, the optimization of reaction time and temperature, sensitivity test and specific test. The results showed that when the annealing temperature was 62 °C and the reaction time was 60 min, the electrophoresis band was the most obvious. The method has good specificity for IBAV without cross reaction to bovine epidemic heat virus (BEFV) and bovine viral diarrhea virus (BVDV). At the same time, the sensitivity is 100 times higher than that of RT-PCR, and the concentration of IBAV gene can be detected to 10 copies/μL. The method can complete the amplification reactiononly with a water bath within 1 hour, simply and efficiently. It provides a new detection method for the preliminary screening and detection of IBAV at the base level.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Hypertension and Inflammation by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of hypertension and inflammation by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: It shows that the current hypertension and inflammation research hotspots had focus on “C-Reactive Protein; Metabolic Syndrome X; Obesity; Endothelium, Vascular; Oxidative Stress”, etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was C-Reactive Protein. Conclusion: It is helpful and timesaving for researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in hypertension and inflammation.

articleTitle: Research on the Undergraduate Cultivation Program of Applied Independent College - Take Yanshan College of Shandong University of Finance and Economics as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The independent college is an undergraduate-level running school organized by ordinary undergraduate colleges according to the new mechanism and new model. It is a higher education institution operated by a private mechanism that combines the advantages of ordinary colleges and universities with high-quality social capital. Since 2014, the State Council, as well as the Ministry of Education, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance and other departments have successively issued decisions and opinions on the transformation of local colleges and universities into application, and clarified the guiding ideology, basics ideas and main tasks.of the transition from undergraduate colleges to applied schools at this level. What kind of talents are cultivated by independent colleges and how to train the talents needed by the society is the focus of the independent college education reform. Based on the reform practice of the undergraduate training program of Yanshan College of Shandong University of Finance and Economics, this paper designs a new undergraduate training program that meets the characteristics of independent colleges from the aspects of target orientation, training mode and curriculum system.

articleTitle: Step-Ring Teaching Mode by Integration of Online Course and Traditional Campus Course
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, in order to make full use of various education resources and improve the teaching effect, paper proposed to integrate online courses with traditional campus classes. The design of teaching is guided by the teaching goal in stages. The online course as preview course, including the theory course and the virtual laboratory, exercises the student's self-study ability; The campus classroom adopts flexible teaching method to cultivate students' comprehensive analytical ability. The experimental class can be a comprehensive experiment to stimulate students' creativity. So that students could get step-by-step promotion. Finally, the teaching design is adjusted by teaching evaluation, then the teaching activities formed a closed circle. The step-ring teaching mode could overcome the disadvantages of online courses and traditional campus classes, train the student's comprehensive quality effectively.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on the Cultivation of Innovative Talents in Automation Specialty Under the Background of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the background of engineering education professional certification, this article puts forward the construction of new training model for automation professionals. This model aims at cultivating engineering innovation and entrepreneurial talents. Through a series of measures such as training program optimization, curriculum system renewal, teaching method reform and practical teaching enhancement, it has realized the cultivation of professional talents with high quality, strong ability and quick adaptability. The practice shows that the new talent training model can effectively improve students' comprehensive quality, practical and innovative abilities, and employment competitiveness.

Author Keywords: automation specialty, engineering education, training mode, innovative and entrepreneurial talents

articleTitle: Clinical Observation and Nursing Experience of Complications in Thyroid Surgery
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Thyroid surgery is a common surgical procedure.However, due to the rich blood circulation of the thyroid gland, the anatomical structure is complex, and it adjacent to the trachea, there are important nerves such as recurrent laryngeal nerve and superior laryngeal nerve.The special surgical site has a high surgical risk and is potentially dangerous with multiple complications.Therefore, the observation and nursing of postoperative complications have important significance for the rehabilitation of patients.We observed and nursed 150 patients undergoing thyroid surgery with satisfactory results.Through the observation and taking care of 135 patients with thyroid surgery,we realize that the nurses post-operative closely observed the condition,comprehensive and meticulous care,early detection of complications and cooper-ation with doctors for treatment and rescue is very important to save the patient's life, reduce the postoperative complicat-ions, and even can influence the prognosis.

articleTitle: Construction of Blended Teaching Based on Network e-Learning Space
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The network learning space "Renrentong" (namely "linking everyone ") is an important component of "three links and two platforms" (referring to "broadband network linking schools, quality resources linking classes, network learning space linking everyone, public service platform for educational resources, and public service platform for educational administration"). This paper introduces the construction and function of network learning space, and analyzes the connotation, targets, as well as meaning of blended teaching. Meanwhile, it constructs a blended teaching mode based on network learning space, and proposes suggestions for blended teaching, to provide references for blended teaching.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of a Non-destructive Detecting System for Oxygen Content in Glass Vials
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Oxygen content in sealed glass vials is a major factor affecting drug quality. At present, sampling destructive testing methods are mainly used to detect residual oxygen in vials by pharmaceutical companies. These methods can lead to low detection efficiency and high missed detection rates. A method for rapidly on-line detecting oxygen content in glass medicine bottles based on wavelength modulation spectroscopy (WMS) technique was proposed and a detecting system with open single optical paths and short optical paths successfully established. On this basis, system parameters were optimized and functions of system software were analyzed to therefore illustrate the data processing procedure and develop the software of detecting system for oxygen content in glass medicine bottles, thus achieving static precise detection. The results showed that the absolute error of static detection for glass medicine bottles with a low concentration was lower than 0.5% and the predicted root-mean-square-error (RMSE) was 0.27%, satisfying the requirements at-line for precise detection.

Author Keywords: Wavelength Modulation Spectroscopy, Parameters Optimization, Savitzky-Golay Filter, Peak area at half maximum, System Software

articleTitle: Research on Anatomy and Molecular Biology of Choiromyces Helanshanensis in Inner Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: the samples collected in the Helan Mountain of Inner Mongolia were studied by Anatomy and molecular biology and found that strain of ascoma was tan, smooth surface, no obvious verrucous protuberance and edges. Gleba of strains was brown, dense, and ivory of vagus veins; Spherical or rod-shaped ascus in honeycomb arrangement contained 1-4 ascospore with package; the surface of ascospore had a protuberant ornamentation and was spherical. Thickness of double wall was about 1.7μm. Diameter of ascospore was 20 microns (including ascospore grain). The molecular evolution analysis shows that the strain was Choiromyces helanshanensis.

Author Keywords: Choiromyces helanshanensis, Ascoma, Anatomical, Molecular Biology

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Decision-Making of New Type Demonstration Based on Air Surveillance Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: According to character characteristics of air surveillance radar equipment development model demonstration, an intelligent decision-making method based on fuzzy measure and Choquet fuzzy integral is proposed. Firstly, the decision-making model is established, the decision index such as comprehensive combat effectiveness, cost, cycle and risk decision-making index are selected and normalized. Where, the comprehensive combat effectiveness index is optimized by D-S Evidence theory and Cloud model theory. According to the correlation of each decision-making index, Fuzzy measure theory is introduced to determine the weight of each decision index. Moreover, decision-making indexes are synthesized by Choquet fuzzy integral and decision-making results are realized. Finally, Simulation results show that the method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Course Assessment Method Based on the Directed Cycle Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to solve the problem in the course process assessment, which is widely used in developed countries, when applied in most of the Universities in China, a course process method based on the directed cycle search algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a process of peer evaluation among the students in the same class is organized and a grade matrix is obtained. Then, a filter algorithm is proposed to remove the possible mendacious grade. Finally, a new score for every student will be generated by a mixed algorithm. An experiment is carried out among a class with 92 students, and the result shows that: 1) the method proposed in this paper could find all the possible mendacious grade in the original matrix; 2) this paper proposes a new approach to carry out an efficient evaluation, which could release the teachers from heavy workforce in the curricula assessment; 3) the method proposed in this paper could find a more true grade for the students from the original one. Also, because the method proposed in this paper is just the primary step to finish the curricula assessment automatically, further researches are needed in the near future.

articleTitle: Design of Exploratory Experiment Based on Constructivism — A Case of Exploratory Experiment of ARP Table Refresh Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The experiment of Network Protocol always takes simple verification as the principal thing, while students lack deep thinking and learning initiative. Constructivist learning theory suggests that students should be put into the center, which they can engage in scenes and collaborative interaction, use their experience to explore new knowledge and construct their own knowledge system. Under the guidance of constructivist learning theory, exploratory experiments are developed and can enhance students' initiative learning ability, practical ability and innovation ability. This paper introduces a group of students as an example, who design the exploratory experiment to verify the ARP table refresh mechanism in ARP protocol, in order to show the important of exploratory experiment to cultivate students' various abilities.

articleTitle: Teaching Content, Case Design and Evaluation System of Mobile Device Programming Course
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Limited by class hours, not all the content of mobile device programming can be involved. For the special specialty, curriculum content of "mobile device programming" should be narrowed. We design the teaching content, teaching case design, experimental content design and evaluation system for mobile device programming teaching, especially for the specialty of information management and information system. Considering the background of information management and knowledge system, our teaching content is focused on the development of information system app. After five semester’s teaching practice, the validity of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Toy Product Risk Monitoring Based on Multi-objective Algorithm Method
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to understand the risk level of hazardous substances in toy products and predict the potential risk of toys, a risk analysis algorithm system for toy product based on multi-objective is designed. Through intelligent method it can achieve a reasonable transforming between parameter of test data and risk monitoring data. At the same time, the multi-objective model analysis is carried out for typical cases. By comparing it with the original results, the research effectively achieves all these goals including rapid find potential risk and quantifies risk value. It provides a systematic evaluation tool in risk monitoring area.

articleTitle: Effects of Tongluo Huoxue Recipe Combined with Nicorandil on Cardiac Function of Stable Angina Pectoris
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose Discussing the effects of Tongluo Huoxue recipe combined with nicorandil on cardiac function of stable angina pectoris. Method Select 120 patients with stable angina pectoris with Qi deficiency and blood stasis treated in our hospital from August 2015 to August 2017.According to random number table method, it is divided into the control group and nicorandil group, the joint group, 40 cases in each. All the patients in the three groups were given conventional drug treatment, and the patients in the nicorandil group were given nicorandil orally on the basis of conventional treatment, 5mg/time, and 3 times/day. In this way, the joint group is given a self-made Traditional Chinese Medicine formula Tongmai Huoxue recipe on the basis of the nicorandil group for treating 4 weeks.The hemorheology indexes of the three groups were observed(Low/high cut viscosity of whole blood, plasma viscosity, hematocrit, fibrinogen), cardiac function index[ventricular ejection fraction (EF),cardiac ejection volume per minute (CO),left ventricular end-diastolic volume (EDV),left ventricular end-systolic volume (ESV),diastolic ventricular septum thickness]level and clinical efficacy,and compare the occurrence of adverse reactions.Result Before treatment, the blood hemorheology index and cardiac function index of the three groups were compared,and the difference was not statistically significant (P>0.05).After treatment,the high cut viscosity of whole blood and hematocrit of the three groups decreased significantly (P<;0.01).The low cut viscosity of whole blood, plasma viscosity, fibrinogen decreased significantly(P<;0.05), and EF increased significantly (P<;0.01), CO increased, ESV decreased (P<;0.05). Moreover, the above indexes in the joint group were significantly better than those in the control group and nicorandil group,with statistically significant differences (P<;0.05). Comparison of the above indexes between the control group and nicorandil group showed no statistically significant difference (P>0.05). Conclusion Tongluo Huoxue recipe combined with nicorandil can effectively reduce that blood viscosity of patient with stable angina pectoris and improve cardiac function,and has remarkable curative effect and no increase in adverse reaction of medicine,having high security.

articleTitle: Exercise and Dietary Intervention in the Management of Overweight and Obese People
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Obesity is a chronic metabolic disease which is relevant to various factors. Obesity is a strong risk factor of many cardiovascular and metabolic diseases and will bring burdens to the life of overweight and obese people. Research showed that most overweight and obesity were caused by unhealthy lifestyle. Therefore, a comprehensive lifestyle intervention based on physical activity, diet and psychology is crucial in the management of overweight and obese people. This study reviewed the current situation of overweight and obesity management strategies, means of interventions and the possible interaction between those interventions. The present study also introduced the diet and exercise prescription of overweight and obese people, and the individualized management scheme for different personal situation. At last, we summarized the shortcomings and difficulties of the present management strategies and propose several key points of management in overweight and obese people according to the demand of individualized management.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Blended Collaborative Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, intelligent mobile devices combined with wireless are building up an ubiquitous learning environment. The ubiquitous blended learning environment has changing the learners’ learning experiences and providing new opportunities for collaborative innovation, which has leading to blended collaborative learning become hot topic in CSCL researches. This paper explored how to design blended collaborative learning based on learners' adaptation. In addition, the author proposed the concrete implementation process of blended collaborative learning.

articleTitle: Technology Introduction and Experience Sharing of Transcutaneous Laryngeal Ultrasonography in Vocal Cord Evaluation before and after Thyroidectomy
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Vocal cord palsy is one of the major complications after thyroid and parathyroid surgeries. It is not only an important procedure related complication, but also a major contributor to medicolegal litigation in thyroid surgery. Flexible laryngo-scopic examination has been the gold standard in assessing the function of the vocal cords and recurrent laryngeal nerve before and after thyroid and parathyroid surgeries. So infor-mation on the patient's preoperative and postoperative vocal cord status is considered essential. However, its routine applic-ation in the perioperative period remains controversial, becau-se preoperative vocal cord palsy is rare, a great majority of patients (particularly those with no voice symptoms or previo-us neck operations) are subjected to unnecessary laryngeal examination. Furthermore, laryngoscopy causes patient disco-mfort and that could potentially lead to poor patient comp-liance to the procedure. Transcutaneous laryngeal ultrasonog-raphy (TLUSG) has been shown recently to be a promising, noninvasive tool in vocal cord examination. Apart from its relative noninvasiveness, it adds very little extra cost, because it can be performed as part of the preoperative examination of the thyroid gland and its regional lymph nodes, and it takes as little as a few minutes. Therefore, it is becoming more popular among clinicians treating thyroid and parathayroid diseases. TLUSG remains a relatively new and evolving imaging techni-que in vocal cord assessment. Using US to evaluate vocal cord movement is not new. However, its clinical utility has so far been limited by a paucity of evidence regarding its validity and reliability. At present, there is rare hospital to carry out this technique in China, and just one literature report in Chinese. The aim of this paper was to introduction this technique as a screening tool for assessment of vocal cord movement in patients before and after undergoing thyroid and parathyroid surgery.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Using the PRISM Model to Improve the Estimated Time of the Project
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article focuses on PRISM, which is a tool developed by the University of Birmingham to analyze probabilistic systems. Through analyzing the mathematical model of estimating the project's expected time using the PERT/CPM network, this paper uses the PRISM method to optimize it, making the whole estimation process more comprehensive and stable, while ensuring the correctness of the final result. After a brief introduction to these two methods, a thorough analysis of the model including the relevant code will be described in detail. Although there are some limitations in the completion probability of the project, this paper generally proves the effectiveness of the PRISM probability model in calculating the expected time of large projects.

articleTitle: E-Learning Pedagogical Strategies in Traditional Medical Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Following the development of the information technology, the traditional medical teaching faced huge challenge. E-learning is a teaching method that is transmitted the knowledge to students through network with computer standardized techniques. As a good complement to the traditional teaching, E-learning became the focus of the education. but for some complicated reasons, this teaching method did not achieve the results that we expected, considering the construction and application of E-learning in the campus, we proposed some strategies to make full use of E-learning.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Neural Network in Intelligent Recommendation for Preventing and Controlling Rocky Desertificatio
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The construction of corresponding match of rocky desertification characteristic information and control mode is the focus and also the difficulty of rocky desertification research. With various ecological, social and economic indicators in the area of rocky desertification as the research object, the data mining theory is innovatively integrated with the regional rocky desertification control mode in this paper. Based on the reasoning of different types of rocky desertification and the combination of bee colony algorithm and BP neural network, this paper is to guide the selection of rocky desertification control mode. Those areas where rocky desertification has been successfully prevented and controlled will be saved in the system as excellent categories. For those new areas needing rocky desertification prevention and control, we can search for similar control mode in the system and modify it to get a suitable one and then to guide relative comprehensive management work. Experimental results show that the proposed method is effective in practice.

Author Keywords: Neural Network, Rocky Desertification, Intelligent Recommendation

articleTitle: The Application of ANSYS in the Teaching of Material Mechanics in Application-Oriented Universities
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, the cultivation of students' skill and ability is ignored in the teaching of material mechanics in many colleges and universities in China. The paper discusses the application of ANSYS software in the teaching of the course, including classroom teaching, after-class exercise and experimental teaching. It is also illustrated by an example of teaching stress concentration. The application cannot only help students to grasp the knowledge of the course, but also help to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve engineering problems.

articleTitle: The Investigation Study on the Stress Coping Styles of Teachers in NanChang Kindergarten
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article mainly analyzes and discusses the The current situation of nanchang preschool teachers stress coping styles and how to improve them.It provides theoretical basis and guidance for optimizing preschool teachers' psychological quality and improving their mental health. Therefore, by using the questionnaire of "Preschool Teachers' stress coping style in Nanchang City", 134 teachers in six kindergartens of different levels in Nanchang were sent out, and the SPSS Statistics 17 statistical software was used to carry out t-tests and variance analysis. The results show that work is the most important source of stress for preschool teachers, and there are significant differences in the coping style of preschool teachers in employer, sex, age, teaching age, marriage and educational level. The following optimization strategies are given: (1) preschool teachers learn to self psychological adjustment; (2) strengthening Psychological Health Education courses in Teachers College; (3) paying attention to the development of young kindergarten teachers; (4) Increasing social support.

articleTitle: The Impact of Occupational Burnout on the Turnover Intention of Traditional Chinese Medicine Doctors in Xianyang
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To understand the status of the occupational burnout and turnover intention of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) doctors in Xianyang. We also explore the influence of occupational burnout on turnover intention. Methods We selected 490 cases of TCM doctors from four Chinese medicine hospitals at the second-class level and above as research objects. Using stratified sampling and cluster sampling, a questionnaire was compiled including the basic situation, occupational burnout and turnover intention of TCM doctors in Xianyang. Results The scores for occupational burnout and turnover intention were 59.21±13.64 and 15.44±3.58, respectively. In addition, the turnover intention among certain ages and technical titles all had statistical differences (P<0.05). Emotional exhaustion and depersonalization dimension of occupational burnout are evidently related to turnover intention (P<0.05). The multiple linear regression analysis showed that the proportion of turnover intention interpreted by sex, age, technical title and educational background was 5.68%, but this proportion increased to 18.17% after adding further components of occupational burnout. Age and emotional exhaustion respectively had the greatest effects on turnover intention (Beta=0.211, －0.357). Conclusion Turnover intention is closely related to the occupational burnout of TCM doctors in Xianyang. We also find that age and emotional exhaustion exert a significant influence on turnover intention.

articleTitle: Validation of Deformable Dose Accumulation for Cervical Cancer Interstitial Brachytherapy
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Accuracy of deformable dose accumulation is challenging in brachytherapy. The purpose of this study is to quantitatively analyze factors impacted on final dose in deformable dose accumulation. Six patients underwent brachytherapy were collected for dose accumulation. A biomechanical model-based registration algorithm was used. Dice similarity coefficient was introduced to quantify the deformable image registration accuracy. Deformable dose was calculated for bladder and rectum, respectively, and D0.1cc, D1cc, D2cc as dose-volume parameters were used to evaluated dose accumulation variation. When selected different image as reference, large dose variation was observed on bladder (34.7%) and rectum (32.7%) for individual patient. For bladder, dose accumulation result was much more strongly related to relative volume than dice similarity coefficient. The results indicate that registration algorithm performed differently on bladder and rectum. Strong negative correlation was found between relative volume and accumulation dose-volume parameters of D1cc and D2cc in bladder. However, DSC score is shown less notable correlated with these dose parameters. Our results suggest that bladder/rectum filling protocol should be used in clinical implementation to reduce variation in dosimetric result.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Development of Discipline Construction in Local University Libraries: Taking Shandong Technology and Business University as an Example
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at exploring the development programs suitable for the discipline resources construction of local university library, this article takes the practice of the discipline resources construction of the local university library as an example to elaborate the research. By analogizing successful cases at home and abroad, and analyzing the current situation and restrictive factors of the local university library, paper proposes to adjust the system, strengthen the construction of discipline team, and gradually promote the development of local university library subject resources.

articleTitle: Finite-Time Recurrent Neural Network Models for Quadratic Program Subject to Time-Varying Linear-Equality Constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To solve the quadratic optimization program, a novel kind of finite-time recurrent neural network (FNN) is presented to improve performance of convergent rate and convergent precision. Compared to the traditional neural network models, FNN is of limited value activation function, which makes the convergent error to equilibrium point within finite time. The activation function for the FNN is required for limited energy, which has a wider application fields. In addition, the finite-time attraction of the matrix differential equation is analyzed, and the experimental results show the FNN models can ensure the convergent rate to zero in finite time. Finally, FNN models are applied to the quadratic optimization problems and redundant manipulator repeatable trajectory planning. Numerical simulation results verify the superiority of the FNN dynamical method.

articleTitle: Keynote Speakers
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Look-Up-Table Decoding and Architecture Optimization for Scale-Min-Sum Polar Decoders
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As to realize believe propagation (BP) for polar decoding, the scaled min-sum (SMS) algorithm is widely used in hardware realization for polar decoders. However, the decoding performance of SMS algorithm is still not good as the length of polar codes increase, and its computing architecture,which called processing elements (PE) needs to be further optimized due to its long critical path. In this paper, referring to the method used in LDPC/Turbo decoding, a look-up-table (LUT) algorithm and its modified version called LUT-SMS are proposed for polar decoding. The simulation result shows that, compared with the SMS algorithm, the proposed LUT-SMS algorithm can lead to 0.3 dB extra decoding gain when the code length up to 2048. For a different trade-off, a new SMS computing architecture which has shorter computing path is proposed to solve the long delay of the polar decoders. The hardware implementation result shows that, the optimized SMS computing architecture can also achieve more than 32% increase in throughput for the case of (256,128) polar decoder without much extra hardware consumption. As a result, both these two optimization schemes have good promotion for polar decoding.

Author Keywords: Polar codes, belief propagation, scaled min sum, look up table, computing path reduction

articleTitle: Unbalance Data Processing Strategy for Protein Interaction Sites Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Protein-protein interactions play essential roles in various biological progresses. Identifying protein interaction sites can facilitate researchers to understand life activities and therefore will be helpful for drug design. However, the unbalance between the negative and positive samples comes from the current definitions of interaction sites places restriction on the prediction of protein interaction sites by computational approaches. In this work, we proposed three imbalance data processing strategies to improve the performance of protein interaction sites prediction. We first proposed the extraction of relevant features based on the evolutionary conservation of amino acids to predict protein interaction sites. At the same time, three methods are proposed to deal with the imbalance of positive and negative samples in data sets. Experimental results demonstrated the effectiveness of our method.

Author Keywords: protein interaction sites, conservative features, unbalanced data sets

articleTitle: Speed Simulator Design for Braking System Validation of High-Speed EMUs
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: It is necessary to continuously validate whether the function and performance of braking system meet the requirements of the specification during the producing, commissioning and maintaining of the high-speed EMU (Electric Multiple Units) trains. But it’s impossible to get the real speed signals, which is one of the core foundations of the validation, in factories or laboratories and it has become a critical challenge for engineers. In this paper, we propose a hardware speed simulator used for braking system validation of the high-speed EMU trains. It’s capable of generating 8 independent speed signals at the same time, and can realize different speed signals under normal braking state and anti-slip braking state. Also it can communicate with the real vehicle hardware. Experiments prove that it can meet the requirement of dynamic validation of the braking system under the condition that the vehicle is stationary. We introduce the principle and main structure of the simulator, then describe the detail design of the core components, and at last give two specific usage processes to help people to understand and use our simulator.

articleTitle: Gene Analysis of Renal Tumor Based on Differential Network
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The vast majority of primary renal tumors were malignant and had a greater damage to the kidneys. The cause and development of tumor diseases were not only related to a single gene, but also caused by molecular aberrations in a network of complex genes or their generations. In this paper, we used differential network analysis method. The gene chip data of renal tumor related gene from Affymetrix hgu13b was firstly screened to obtain differential expressed genes, and the gene network was constructed separately under disease samples and normal samples. Secondly, the difference between disease network and normal genes was constructed, and the renal tumor related gene was analyzed. In our differential network model, we used a more accurate method than before. What's more, we used Bayesian information criteria to adjust the parameters, and the gene network under two different conditions was coded as the difference between the precision covariance matrices. More than two hundred pairs of gene pairs were identified from the differential network. Based on the differential network analysis of the central gene, GO enrichment analysis showed that the gene TBX3 had the highest degree of enrichment, indicating that it may be related to the formation of renal tumors. In the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis, it was found that p<;0.05 was mainly enriched as a chemokine pathway, and chemokines had an important influence on the occurrence, metastasis and treatment of renal tumors.

articleTitle: Experiment and Thinking of Mobile Platform in Teaching of Medical University
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Use the mobile platform (taking Chaoxing APP as an example) to assist the teaching of principles and equipment of medical imaging course. Then evaluate the teaching effect by measurement data, questionnaire survey and interview. The results indicate that, this teaching mode with mobile platform is applicable not only in principles and equipment of medical imaging course, but also in providing a reference value in teaching reform in medical universities, for its function of improving students’ subjective initiative and strengthening the communication between teachers and students.

articleTitle: A Case of Secondary Bloodthirsty Syndrome in Still's Disease in Adults
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Hematopoietic syndrome (HPS) is a rare, severe disease characterized by abnormal activation of macrophages that results in the phagocytosis of large numbers of blood cells. Typical features include fever, hepatosplenomegaly, lymphadenopathy, hypocytopenia, and low fibrinogenemia. Symptoms, ferritinemia. HPs are divided into two subtypes: Primary HPs are autosomal recessive inherited diseases. Secondary HPS often secondary to infectious diseases, malignant tumors, autoimmune diseases. Adult onset still disease (AOSD) is a group of etiologies, pathogenesis is unclear, clinically characterized by high fever, transient pleomorphic rash, arthritis or joint pain, accompanied by peripheral granulocytes. Increased, liver, spleen and lymphadenopathy and other multi-system involvement of a clinical syndrome. In this paper, we retrospectively analyzed the data of one case of adult HPs with Stille disease to improve the understanding of the disease and improve the early diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model of Flat Folding Table
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the design of folding table, we should consider three evaluation indexes: good product stability, easy processing and least material. The stability of the product is characterized by the angle of tilt of the legs and the distance between the legs of the table through force analysis; the convenience of processing is characterized by minimizing the maximum slot length. Therefore, based on these three indicators, a multi-objective programming model is established. In solving the model, the weight with good stability, convenient processing and least material consumption is obtained by AHP, and the multi-objective programming is transformed into single-objective programming. For the given height of the folding table and the diameter of the circular table, the optimum design and machining parameters such as the position of the steel bar and the size of the plate are obtained according to the model.

articleTitle: Extracting Photoplethysmographic Waveform from Bulbar Conjunctiva Video
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Recently the conjunctival vascularity measurement based on image analysis has shown great potential in physiological monitoring and biometrics. However, the motion artifacts in the conjunctiva videos cause both large displacement and distinct illumination variety. In this paper, a novel approach is proposed to extract photoplethysmographic waveform from conjunctiva video. Which consists of video stabilization and dual-channel extraction to eliminate the two facets of the motion artifacts respectively. The heart rate measuring results have shown a good agreement between our method and the fingertip oximeter.

articleTitle: Study on the Treatment of Complication of Sepsis by Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: this study focuses on the effect of traditional Chinese and Western medicine on complication of sepsis. Method: in order to improve the correctness and authenticity of the research results, this study selected the patients diagnosed as complication of sepsis in our hospital as the object of the study. The data of the study were 64 cases, and all the subjects were divided into average groups, the observation group and the control group were 32 cases each from April 2017 to June 2018. The control group was treated with simple western medicine. On the basis of the control group, the observation group was treated with self-designed Fuzheng Jiedu prescription, and the outcome of the two groups was compared, the APACHE II score and the fatality rate of 28d patients after treatment were compared. [Results]: the study showed that the effective rate of the observation group was much higher than that of the control group. After treatment, the APACHE II score was also significantly lower than that of the control group, and the difference between the two groups was significant. [Conclusion]: to sum up, the patients with complication of sepsis complicated by traditional Chinese and western medicine can effectively improve their recovery and rehabilitation and without adverse reactions, which is worthy of further clinical application.

Author Keywords: traditional Chinese and western medicine treatment

articleTitle: A Research on the Present Situation and Strategies of Pre-Service Teachers' TPACK Competence
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the present situation of pre-service teachers' TPACK competence, analyze the effect of pre-service teachers TPACK competence by demographic variables (gender, subject and background), find the reasons for situation analysis and give the corresponding strategy. In this study, 97 pre-service teachers of a normal university in Hubei province of China were selected as the samples, and a quantitative approach was implemented. The results showed that the pre-service teachers had good TPACK competence. Through descriptive analysis, the Ethics dimension was the highest and the Proficiency dimension was the lowest in all the dimensions of TPACK competence. Through ANOVA analysis, it revealed that gender, subject and background had no significant effect on the pre-service teachers' TPACK competence. Finally, some strategies are proposed to improve pre-service teachers' TPACK competence by the findings.

Author Keywords: TPACK, pre-service teacher, TPACK-deep scale, situation and strategy

articleTitle: An Approach to Cultivate Graduate's Innovative Ability Based on Creative Practice
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Innovative ability is one of the necessary abilities of the graduates, which is also the inevitable requirement for graduate education. There are many different approaches to achieve this goal. Practice plays very important role in the cultivation of the graduates' innovative ability. Innovative ability cultivation needs powerful practice design. Creative practice is described in this paper. Creative practice is aimed to improve the practice during the process of graduate cultivation. The graduates are divided into different small teams. These teams will join different research and technical works, which have some competition features. Guided by the direction of professional team works, the teams will participate in academic competitions, which will make the graduates master the knowledge and have the professional skills. Further, it will inspire and cultivate the graduates' innovative ability through such team works with competition features. Existing investigations show that the approach in this paper is helpful in cultivating graduates' innovative practical ability.

articleTitle: Influence of Occupational Commitment on the Occupational Stability of Traditional Chinese Medicine Doctors in Xianyang
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To examine and better understand the status of the occupational commitment and occupational stability of doctors practicing traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in Xianyang. We also explore the influence of occupational commitment on occupational stability. Methods We selected 490 cases of TCM doctors from four Chinese medicine hospitals at the second-class level and above as research objects. Using stratified sampling and cluster sampling, a questionnaire was compiled. The answers gave us a better understanding of the basic situation, occupational commitment and occupational stability of doctors using TCM in Xianyang. Results The scores for occupational commitment and occupational stability were 81.78±14.26 and 15.44±3.58, respectively. In addition, the occupational commitment among those with a technical title, and the occupational stability among certain ages and technical titles all had statistical differences (P<0.05). Every dimension of occupational commitment is evidently related to occupational stability (P<0.05). The multiple regression analysis showed that the proportion of occupational stability interpreted by sex, age, technical title and educational background was 5.28%, but this proportion increased to 29.19% after adding further components of occupational commitment. Age, emotional commitment, normative commitment and opportunity commitment, respectively, had the greatest effects on occupational stability (Beta=0.158, 0.307, 0.217, －0.167). Conclusion Occupational stability is closely related to the occupational commitment of TCM doctors in Xianyang. We also find that age, emotional commitment, normative commitment and opportunity commitment all exert a significant influence on occupational stability.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of Entrepreneurial Education on Entrepreneurial Intention of College Students
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the questionnaire result of 5874 students in 25 colleges over China, this paper probes into the causal impact of entrepreneurial education on entrepreneurial intention. A triple-ISO mode with generalized entrepreneurial attitude(GEA), personal background and entrepreneurial intention is conceptualized. GEA consists of entrepreneurial motivation, knowledge of entrepreneurial elements, and perception of the environment, whereas personal background encompasses personal social background and education. With structural equation modeling and analysis of variance, it is found that entrepreneurial education significantly influences intention directly, and also indirectly through GEA as an intermediate variable. As a result, entrepreneurial education of college students ought to be emphasized.

Author Keywords: college students, generalized entrepreneurial attitude, personal background, entrepreneurial education

articleTitle: The Intelligent Use of Screen Language in New Media Short Documentary
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper takes the new media short documentary as the starting point, and expounds the background of short documentary film. In terms of the definition of a short documentary, it also analyzes and summarizes the language rules for short documentary in the aspect of picture language. In order to realize the intelligent application of picture language in new media short documentary, this paper utilizes the improved Apriori algorithm to conduct mining analysis and tests the efficiency of the algorithm. The results show that the optimized algorithm is benefit for lifting speed. It will deepen the knowledge and the understanding of picture language in the intelligent use of new media short documentary.

articleTitle: PTA Scoring Analysis Based on Statistical Method in a MOOC
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: More and more computer courses change the teaching model. In order to improve the efficiency of learning data structure, a teaching method based on MOOC and Programming Teaching Assistant (PTA) is proposed. In order to investigate PTA effect on the learning scores of the students, we use statistical methods to analyze a total of 188 students from 4 classes about PTA scores and examination test scores. The results reveal that 87.7% students which pass PAT, pass examination test, which prove that the PAT could be helpful for the students to master the knowledge points. In order to investigate the performance of the exercises set of each chapter in PTA, we analyze 188 students' PTA scores of each chapter, and find that the results of four chapters are not ideal and other four chapters are very reasonable. In the next term, we will modify the exercises sets in order to facilitate the students' learning.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Quality Early-Warning System for University Personnel Training
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the necessity of early warning on the quality of personnel training in colleges and universities, probes into the early warning contents, indicators and the delimitation of warning lines related to the quality of personnel training in colleges and universities, and on this basis puts forward a early warning management system in order to accurately describe the operational situation of personnel training in colleges and universities, the training process and various influencing factors. We hope to provide forward-looking and guiding suggestions for colleges and universities to formulate policies and determine the direction of development.

articleTitle: Model Checking the Reliability of Data Center Network
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Data center network provides a basis for internet-based applications nowadays, thereby the reliability of it is vital. The purpose of this research is to examine and compare the reliability of two data center network architectures, which are Common Tree and Fat-tree topology structure. To verify the reliability of these two architectures, a tool called PRISM with the function of probabilistic model checking is used in this paper. Results show that Fat-tree topology structure is more reliable than Common Tree, and the reliabilities of core layer, edge/ aggregation layer and terminal layer decline sequentially.

Author Keywords: Common data center topology, Fat tree topology, Model checking, PRISM, CTMC

articleTitle: Periodic Solutions of Second Order Singular Damped Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: A class of second order singular damped differential equations by combining the analysis of the sign of Green's functions for the linear damped equation is studied in this paper. There are not so many existence results on this model. By using a nonlinear alternative principle of Leray-Schauder, the existence of positive periodic solutions for this model is proved.

articleTitle: MobMivs: Implementing an Efficient Medical Image Visualization System for Mobile Telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As medical devices have excellent resolutions and have become better connected to the Internet, doctors and patients are beginning to expect medical images to be available on mobile device for making a diagnosis or consultative viewing. However, the performance of querying and accessing medical images in anytime and anywhere using mobile device is still an issue. In this paper, we implement an medical image visualization system to efficiently query and access medical images by using smartphone, which has the following new features: 1) an on-demand data transmission method is implemented using DICOM web service, and only the required meta data and image region or series are transmitted to mobile device; 2) a high performance cache component is designed to cache the recently requested images, which takes up less storage and obtains higher performance; 3) a convenient way is introduced to quickly obtain a specific patient's studies by scanning a patient's barcode or quick response code. The performance and stability of our proposed method as well as the prototype system is evaluated with real DICOM data sets. The results show that our app obtains high performance and stability in both Wi-Fi and 4G mobile network, which is expected to be an effective tool for mobile telemedicine.

Author Keywords: Mobile medical image system, DICOM, Web service, Mobile device

articleTitle: Combine Trust and Interest Similarity for Enhanced-Quality Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Collaborative filtering based methods have a low performance in the context of social recommendation due to the data sparsity issue and not considering the social network information that can be exploited to improve the performance. Trust-based methods attempt to reduce the data sparsity by utilizing the social network information. In this paper, we propose a hybrid personal trust model which adaptively combines the rating-based trust model and explicit trust metric to resolve the drawback caused by insufficient past rating records. The proposed method takes user-item matrix and user interaction information as inputs, and calculates the degree of direct trust to produce an initiative trust matrix. Then, following the predefined trust propagation rules, the algorithm infers the degree of indirect trust between users and transforms the initiative trust matrix to a denser trust matrix. The denser trust matrix and rating matrix are collectively used to find the k nearest neighbors for the target user. We present our empirical experiments in a real sparse data set MovieLens, the experimental results shows our algorithm can increase the data density and achieve lower MAE, that is to say, the proposed approach can efficiently improve recommendation quality.

articleTitle: Research on Individual Visitor Modeling Based on Learning Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularization of Science education, the informal environment such as the science and technology museum can show the cultural connotation of different themes and present a diverse educational environment across participants of different age groups to meet the public's need for cultural enhancement. As one of the informal scientific learning places, the science and technology museum have increasingly confirmed that it has enormous educational potential. In this paper, we apply the learning analysis technology in analyzing and excavating the related behavior of the individual in the science and technology museum and construct an individual visitor model on the basis of analysis of the key problems in the science and technology museum visitor modeling, so as to evaluate, predict and adjust the effect of exhibitions in the museum and enhance its scientific education effectiveness.

articleTitle: Barcode Music Score
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Numbered music notation and staff music notation are two common music score for recording music, which existed for many decades. These two types of music notation are convenient for music learners and musicians, but not for the automatic recognition devices, such as the intelligent mobile phones with cameras. The existing OMR researches on sheet music score recognition mainly focus on the recognition accuracy of the original sheet music score. In this paper, a new solution is proposed for the automatic music score recognition based on inventing a new type of music score using two dimensional barcode technology, named barcode music score. First, the music score is transformed and encoded into a two dimensional barcode. Then this barcode can be decoded to music melody by scanning it using an intelligent mobile device with a built-in camera and an accustomed playing APP. As the barcode music score can be decoded by a mobile device, then it provides a new convenient way for music self-learning except reading the original sheet music score, especially for the children in the less developed areas, with less music teachers.

articleTitle: Case-Based Teaching on Designing and Realizing an Innovation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents concepts on designing and realizing a novel algorithm which can be of significance for teaching purpose. In order to interpret novelty in any new algorithm, in this work a new conceptual case-based is introduced based on tree biomechanics. Firstly, core terminologies such as initialization, exploration and exploitation paradigm, and termination criterion are explained thoroughly. Moreover, a detailed mathematical formulation is constructed. Hence, the mathematical derivation and explanation on core algorithmic terminologies will be of high value in teaching and designing new algorithm. The stepwise procedure of mathematic is deduced for the experimental and statistical analysis. Thus, the experiment was carried out on 13 set of constrained benchmark optimization problems. Consequently, the results obtained by the proposed method are compared with results of other methods from the literature. The proposed method has shown effectiveness in solving constrained optimization problems and it is comparable or better than other methods in the literature.

Author Keywords: case based teaching, simulation experiment, bionics, evolutionary algorithms

articleTitle: Neck Hematoma Caused by Spontaneous Hemorrhage of Thyroid: Experience Sharing and Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Spontaneous hematoma of the neck is rare, but it can enda-nger life. There are a variety of causes, including aneurysm, infection, the rupture and bleeding of the thyroid and paratha-yroid tumor. The clinical symptoms include swelling of the neck, displacement of the trachea, subcutaneous congestion in the pharynx and neck, severe dyspnea and even asphyxia. Due to the particularity of the anatomical structure of the neck, the hematoma can develop to airway pressure and even life threa-tening in hours to days. The clinical course was usually divided into two steps, initially with limited extravasation of the blood and then suddenly expanding to the whole neck to make it difficult to breathe. It is rare for the cervical hematoma and asphyxia caused by spontaneous hemorrhage of the thyroid gland. Only 30 cases have been reported in the relevant liter-ature. In this paper, a case of emergency surgical treatment for the cervical hematoma and dyspnea caused by the thyroid gla-nd was introduced, and related literature was reviewed and summarized. We summarizeed the experience reported in the literature, and drew the following conclusions. The incidence of spontaneous neck hematoma was the same on the left side as right side, the majority patient were elderly people. The avera-ge age was 62 years old, and there were more women than men. There was a certain correlation between thyroid spontaneous bleeding and the underlying thyroid diseases. The thyroid arte-ry aneurysm was the common etiology, among which the most common was the inferior thyroid artery aneurysms. The survi-val rate of positive surgery or embolization was higher than that of conserveative observation.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation of the Teaching Mode of Ideological and Political Theory Course Based on the Big Data Teaching Assisted Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To promote the teaching reform of the ideological and political theory course by virtue of modern information technology and increase students' learning interests and teaching effectiveness, big data technology is used to explore a new teaching model for the ideological and political theory course. Network space of teaching activity of the ideological and political theory course is expanded through the construction of big data teaching support platform, which provides plenty of accurate and real-time data for students' learning and creates an online learning platform for students. Systematic changes are produced in teaching idea, teaching methods, and teaching process of the ideological theoretical course drawn support from big data, thereby forming a new teaching model for the big-data ideological and political theory course. This new model fully develops the advantages and functions of big data technology, improves the scientific nature and effectiveness of teaching for the ideological and theoretical course, and is conducive to realizing the basic target of cultivating students' socialist value outlook.

articleTitle: Clinical Efficacy of Xi Sanzang Decoction Assisted Knee Arthroscopic Treatment for Knee Osteoarthritis Due to Deficiency of Liver and Kidney and Its Influence on Serum Cytokines
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the clinical efficacy of Xi Sanzang Decoction assisted knee arthroscopic treatment for knee osteoarthritis (KOA). Methods: A total of 82 patients with KOA due to deficiency of liver and kidney were selected and randomized into treatment group and control group using random number table. Treatment group was treated with knee arthroscopic rinsing followed by Xi Sanzang Decoction which was decocted by water and administered orally, bid, 7 days as a cycle. Control group was treated with Glucosamine Hydrochloride Capsules, 2 capsules per time, tid, 7 days as a cycle. The improvement of Lysholm score and visual analogue scale (VAS) score before and after treatment, the clinical efficacy and the levels of serum cytokines were observed in both groups after 2 cycles of treatment. Results: (1) Intra-group comparison: Lysholm score and VAS score were significantly improved after treatment than treatment before in both groups, and there were significant differences (P<;0.01). (2) Inter-group comparison after treatment: Treatment group was prominently better in Lysholm score and VAS score and evidently higher in clinical efficacy than those in control group, and there were significant differences (P<;0.05). (3) Treatment group was notably lower than control group in the serum levels of interleukin-1 (IL-1) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) after treatment, and there were significant differences (P<;0.05). Conclusion: Xi Sanzang Decoction assisted knee arthroscopic treatment is excellent in clinical efficacy and safe and reliable in clinical application for KOA.

Author Keywords: knee osteoarthritis, knee Bi syndrome, knee arthroscope, Glucosamine Hydrochloride

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Vectorcardiography by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the research hotspots of vectorcardiography by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 7838 papers analyzed, it shows that the current vectorcardiography research hotspots had focused on “Body Surface Potential Mapping; Electrocardiography; Myocardial Infarction; Heart Conduction System; Catheter Ablation; Atrial Fibrillation”, etc, it also suggests that the most importance of which was "Body Surface Potential Mapping" and "Electrocardiography". Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about vectorcardiography. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in vectorcardiography.

articleTitle: Building Discipline Knowledge Repository Based on Wiki Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Discipline knowledge repository is a collection of knowledge of a specific subject field, and is an important teaching assistant resource. Wiki is a new kind of knowledge management software on which users can collaboratively create and modify content .We can build an open discipline knowledge repository based on Wiki technology. This paper analyzes the advantages of building a discipline knowledge repository based on Wiki, points out that the Wiki knowledge base can not only provide rich and systematic teaching auxiliary resources, promote students’ initiative in learning, but also can realize the innovation of knowledge through the cooperation of groups. This paper also describes in detail the basic function and structure of a knowledge base, and presents the main steps of building a discipline knowledge repository based on Wiki

articleTitle: Chaotic Evolution with Random Crossover Rate in Single Objective Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: We investigate optimization performance of chaotic evolution algorithm with random crossover rate by comparing the ones with constant crossover rate. We found that searching around the target vector is always useful for optimization by analysing convergent results. Setting a big crossover rate at the initial generation and small one in the end are great strategies of crossover rate setting for chaotic evolution. It presents exploitation and exploration capabilities of chaotic evolution algorithm. However, in the more benchmark cases' condition, chaotic evolution algorithms with any crossover rate setting have the same search performance from multivariate statistical test. We found that search with a large crossover rate in the beginning, and do with a small one at the end, it can enhance search capability of chaotic evolution algorithm. We also discuss and analyse related issues, open topics, and future works on crossover rate of chaotic evolution algorithm.

Author Keywords: chaotic evolution, single objective chaotic evolution, random crossover, chaos theory, chaotic optimization

articleTitle: Research on the Utilization and Supply-Demand Relationship of Digital Resources from the Perspective of Discipline
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Library digital resource construction is of great significance to discipline construction. Based on COUNTER reports, statistical analysis method and citation analysis method are applied in this paper to analyze the utilization of electronic journals from the perspective of discipline, as well as the supply-demand relationship. The paper compares the use of e-journals of Nanjing University with that of other universities. The result shows that electronic journals are not fully utilized. We suggest that academic libraries should keep up with the discipline development and digital resource utilization. The paper provides reference for the application of digital resource usage statistics.

Author Keywords: library, digital resources, citation analysis, COUNTER

articleTitle: Research Hotspots Analysis of Cardiovascular Model by PubMed
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To understand the recent 10 years research hotspots of cardiovascular model by PubMed. Methods: With MS Excel, SPSS, Cytoscape software, we took MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) word frequency analysis, clustering analysis, co-word network graph of PubMed papers. Results: By MeSH of 9137 papers analyzed, it shows that the current cardiovascular model research hotspots had focused on “Heart Conduction System; Computer Simulation; Heart; Hemodynamics; Blood Pressure; Algorithms; Blood Flow Velocity”, etc, it also suggests that the top 2 importance of which was "Heart Conduction System" and "Computer Simulation". Conclusion: With multi-angle analysis of bibliometrics, we understand the outline of research hotspots about cardiovascular model. It is helpful and time saving for the researcher or doctor to understand the research hotspots in cardiovascular model.

articleTitle: Clinical Observation of Traditional Chinese Baduanjin Qigong (Eight Trigrams Boxing) in the Treatment of Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe the influence of traditional Chinese Baduanjin Qigong (Eight trigrams boxing) on fasting plasma glucose (FPG), postprandial 2-h blood glucose (2hPG) and glycosylated hemoglobin (HbA1c) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and to assess the clinical efficacy of this method. Methods: A total of 60 patients with T2DM were randomized into Baduanjin intervention group, walking aerobic exercise group, and education control group, 20 cases in each group. In education control group, western medicines were administered to control blood glucose to standard level, common education and nutritional recipes for diabetes mellitus were given, and original lifestyle was maintained. In Baduanjin intervention group, Baduanjin Qigong was initiated based on the treatment in education control group, 2 times daily, for 5 days weekly. In walking aerobic exercise group, walking was initiated based on the treatment in education control group, 2 times daily, 30 min at each time, for 5 days weekly. All groups were treated for 3 months, after which the changes of FPG, 2hPG and HbA1c levels before and after interventions were detected. Results: After 3-month interventions, 2hPG level decreased markedly in all groups than that before intervention (P<;0.05), which decreased more significantly in Baduanjin intervention group that that in other 2 groups (P<;0.05). Relative to education control group, Baduanjin intervention group was prominently lower in the levels of FPG and HbA1c (P<;0.05). Conclusion: Traditional Chinese Baduanjin Qigong can reduce the levels of FPG, 2hPG and HbA1c in patients with T2DM, thus deserving to be further studied and applied.

Author Keywords: Traditional Chinese Qigong, Baduanjin Qigong, type 2 diabetes mellitus, fasting plasma glucose, postprandial 2-h blood glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin

articleTitle: Construction of Interlibrary Loan Information System Based on SaaS Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
