abstract: In order to increase sharing level and effect of books and information between libraries, construction of books-checkout information system in the interlibrary using the system architecture of SaaS (Software as a Service), books- checkout information system consists of four modules, including administrator management, user management, function management and literature management. The system structure and module design of information system software are also introduced in detail, and function analysis of each module are made, task content of each module is designed, the relation between entity class and attribute involved in information system are demonstrated, and system class diagram is listed, finally main module function of information system is implemented by Java Web technology and mysql database

articleTitle: Primary Hyperparathyroidism Caused by Ectopic Parathyroid Adenoma: Experience Sharing and Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In parathyroid surgery, the incidence of ectopic parathy-roid glands was 6.3% to 16%. In parathyroid gland reop-eration, the incidence of ectopic parathyroid glands was 45%. The inferior parathyroid gland is most common ectopic located in the former mediastinum, often embedded in the thymus. The superior parathyroid gland is often located in the posteri-or longitudinal mediastinum. According to the reports, Prima-ry Hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) caused by mediastinal para-thayroid adenoma has a more severe clinical manifestation and higher serum calcium more likely to have bone involvement. Therefore, early diagnosis of mediastinal ectopic parathyroid adenoma is essential. When PTH and calcium ions was eleva-ted and diagnosis of primary hyperparathyroidism was clear, if 99mTc-MIBI scintigraphy was negative, ectopic parathyroid glands might need to be considered. We need choose other auxiliary examination methods such as neck-chest CT or MRI, and expand the scope of the 99mTc-MIBI scan, including the neck and mediastinum. Understand the predilection sites of ectopic parathyroid glands, frequency, and its scoping, helps to locate ectopic parathyroid before and during surgery. The uptake of 99mTc-MIBI has been associated with factors such as blood flow, size, and mitochondrial activity in parathyroid hyperplasia/adenomas. When parathyroid adenoma cystic deg-eneration occurs, located in the thyroid, small in size, asym-metrically hyperplastic or when the function is not significant, 99mTc-MIBI is easy to show false negatives. The results of false positives in the mediastinum may be metastatic lung cancer, thymomas, seminomas, or lymphomas. Raising awareness of ectopic parathyroids to reduce clinical missed, misdiagnosed and easily to find ectopic parathyroid glands is of great help. Our hospital had treated a case of PHPT caused by ectopic parathayroid adenoma in the mediastinal, now reported as follows.

articleTitle: Design of Simulated CCU Used for High-Speed EMU Engineers Training
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The training of engineers is very important for the safety of high-speed railways. However, the high cost of real devices have restricted the production of training equipment and affected the training of engineers. To address this problem, this paper proposes a simulated CCU (center control unit) referring to the famous high-speed EMU train CRH380B. It can be used to manufacture the braking system training equipment (BSTE) of the high-speed EMU train. It is mainly composed of one host, two displays, one MVB card and one switch output module. This equipment can realize all functions of the real CCU performed in the braking system of CRH380B, including device management, communication management and faults reporting. In addition, it can communicate and work with other real components of the braking system. We discuss the principle of the simulated CCU and then give the detailed composition structure and electrical connections, at last, introduce the usage procedures and the braking experiments. Experiments show that, the cost of the simulated CCU only 5% of the real equipment, which can greatly reduce the development cost of the training equipment.

articleTitle: Establishment of RT-LAMP Detection Method for Bluetongue Virus
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to establish the RT-LAMP detectionmethod of bluetongue virus (BTV), 4 specific LAMP primers were designed and synthesized by using the conservative sequence of the BTV VP7 genome published by GenBank. Through the synthesis of BTV artificial genes, the optimization of the reaction conditions of LAMP, the LAMP sensitivity experiment of BTV and the specific experiments, a preliminary method of BTV LAMP detection was established. The results showed that the BTV gene was successfully synthesized and the LAMP reaction conditions were optimized preliminarily, and the detection limit of the developed BTV LAMP method system could reach 43.7 copies/ ?L of target gene fragment, which could be detected with good sensitivity and specificity. In the experiment, the BTV virus could be amplified with a good specific amplification at 62? and 60min, and the results were negative after the amplification of DNA of Escherichia coli and Escherichia coli under the system constructed by the experiment.

articleTitle: Study on the Strategy of Large-Class Teaching for Sensor Courses
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Sensor courses are taught in large classes in many universities, which sets obstacles to the improvement of course quality. During large-class teaching, interaction between teacher and students, as well as that among students, becomes more difficult to achieve. When students are at different levels and their abilities to receive differ, unified teaching will lead to low participation. Thus, corresponding solutions are proposed, which means that it is necessary to stimulate students' interest in learning things, to combine large-class teaching and small-class discussion, to merge positive psychology into the large-class teaching, to update and expand teaching contents in which students are interested, so as to improve the teaching quality of large class.

articleTitle: Risk Factors Analysis of 48 Cases of Brain Metastases in Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To investigate the risk factors of brain metastasis in breast cancer and provide clinical basis for the forecast. Methods Input the data of 520 cases of hospital-patient in breast cancer with more complete information to the Excel, use of SAS (version 8.0) statistical package for Log-rank test for univariate analysis, analysis the associated-factors between breast cancer and brain metastasis ;apply COX regression model to understand the impact of breast cancer brain metastases in multiple factor analysis .Results Log-rank test analysis the factors on the impact of breast cancer brain metastases, showed that the pathological types, human epidermal growth factor receptor type 2（HER-2） impact brain metastases from breast cancer. Set up the COX stepwise regression model analysis. The results showed that age, HER-2, the impact of histological types of breast cancer were independent factors in brain metastases. There were correlation between the pathological type and HER-2 In 48 cases of breast cancer brain metastases, suggesting that the pathological type of invasive ductal carcinoma with HER-2 high expression of brain metastases occured more easily. Conclusion HER-2 over-expression, a relatively young age, pathological type was invasive ductal carcinoma, simple carcinoma, mixed carcinoma, should be alert to the occurrence of brain metastases. Patients with breast cancer after surgey about six years and a half should be alert to the occurrence of brain metastases.

Author Keywords: Breast cancer, Brain metastasis, Risk factors, COX model

articleTitle: Design and Development of Intelligent Torsion Pendulum Method for Rotational Inertia Measurement Experiment
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Moment of inertia is a measure of inertia when a rigid body rotates. Measuring the moment of inertia of a particular object is of great significance to some research and design work. This paper describes a torsion pendulum device based on 89C51 microcontroller for measuring moment of inertia. 89C51 is used as the control core, and the accurate timing is carried out by using photoelectricity to cooperate with single chip microcomputer. C program is used in the software system, and a variety of friction reduction design, such as changing the surface contact to the line contact, is adopted to improve the measurement accuracy and greatly reduce the error.

articleTitle: Evidence Fusion Algorithm Based on Correction Conflict
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to solve the shortcomings of traditional D_S evidence theory in dealing with conflict evidence,this paper presents a new measure. This method combines the evidence distance with the normalization constant to determine the degree of conflict between the evidences. The degree of conflict as the basis for judging the conflict evidence. Calculates the trust degree and the false degree of the evidence, sorts the trust degree and the false degree of the evidence respectively, then weights the conflict evidence. Finally, use the Dempster combination rule as evidence fusion. Experiments show that the algorithm not only judge the conflict evidence effectively, but also improve the convergence speed and precision.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform Design Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper analyzes some problems in the teaching process of "Information Theory and Coding". According to the characteristics of the course and the teaching process, a new teaching method is proposed, which focuses on cultivating students' multi-faceted ability. This article explores new teaching methods on the basis of theoretical teaching, focusing on cultivating students' multi-faceted abilities. This teaching method, through the practice and self-learning process, takes the design of the coding and decoding structure of LDPC code as an example, combines theory with practice, stimulates students' self-learning consciousness, deepens theoretical understanding, and cultivates compound talents.

Author Keywords: interactive classroom teaching model, Matlab, teaching reformation, both learn and practice

articleTitle: The Application of Sandwich Method in Experimental Teaching of Molecular Biology Based on qPCR Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Experimental teaching is an important part in the cultivation of molecular biology majors or relevant professionals. It is very necessary to develop comprehensive exploratory experiments to improve the quality of molecular biology experiment teaching. Applying Quantitative Real-time PCR (qPCR) as core technology and “Sandwich teaching method” in lesson delivery, we opened an exploratory experimental course on molecular biology for postgraduate students. This article described the objectives of the course, the design of content, program arrangement and so on, discussed the application and effect of Sandwich teaching method in molecular biology teaching. The results showed that this experimental item not only can leverage understanding the theoretical knowledge of molecular biology, but also efficiently improve the subjective initiative of postgraduate students, is beneficial to cultivate the ability of systematical analysis and scientific research.

articleTitle: Surgical Treatment of Differentiated Thyroid Carcinoma Originating in the Isthmus (a Literature Review)
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Papillary thyroid carcinoma originating in the isthmus accounts for 1.0%-9.2% of papillary thyroid carcinoma.There is no specific thyroid cancer originating in the isthmus treatment guidelines including American Thyroid Association (ATA), British Thyroid Association (BTA), European Thyroid Association (ETA). The characteristics of thyroid cancer in isthmus was as follows:1 Thyroid carcinoma of the isthmus is more likely to invade the capsule, multifocal lesions and central lymph node metastasis. 2 Expanded resection of the isthmus is only applicable to selected cases. Most isthmus cancers undergo total thyroidectomy. 3 Papillary thyroid carcinoma is a low-grade malignant tumor with rare distant metastases. It is mainly metastasized to the lungs and bones and the prognosis is poor. 4 There is no report of distant metastasis of thyroid isthmus. Conclusions:1 Thyroid isthmus cancer is still a malignant tumor with a good prognosis. 2 Biological characteristics: multifocal; easy to central lymph node metastasis (anterior larynx, pretrachea); easy to invade the capsule, resulting in tracheal, ribbon muscle invasion; tumor diameter size with central lymph node metastasis was not significantly related. 3 Surgery is still controversial, with total thyroidectomy+ bilateral central area dissection, some patients consider extended thyroid isthmusectomy.

articleTitle: Cross-Sectional Survey on Sub-Health Status of College Students in a Medical School of Shaanxi Province in 2016
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To investigate the sub-health status and its influencing factors of medical college students in Shaanxi province, and to provide the basis for the formulation of intervention measures. Method We selected total of 776 undergraduates in a medical college in Shaanxi province as the research objects. We used “the China's urban residents sub-health status self-rating scale" to collect information and analyzed the factors which affecting Sub-health of College Students by Multi - factor Logistics Regression. Results It can be seen from this study that the detection rate of sub-health of medical college students is 31.19%, and the fourth grade detection rate of sub-health is higher than that of other grades (F=11.476, P= 0.000), the detection rate of students who’s living expenses under 800 yuan increased significantly than other students. (F=8.732, P=0.000). After using the multivariate logistic regression analysis methods, we found that diet situation (OR = 0.732), physical exercise (OR = 0.617), stay up all night (OR = 1.378), employment pressure (OR = 2.453), cell phone usage (OR = 1.907), emotional condition (OR = 1.530), and psychological condition (OR = 1.601) are all the factors of sub-health. The protective factor of sub - health status of college students are eating on time, regular physical exercise. While often stay up all night, the employment pressure, longtime use of mobile phone, anxiety and unhealthy psychological feelings are the risk factors of sub - health status. Conclusion The sub-health detection rate of medical college students is lower than non-medical college students. So maintain the regular, good habits and living conditions, adhere to physical exercise, rational and scientific use of mobile phones, ease their employment pressure and negative emotions, are the effective measures for improving the health status of college students.

articleTitle: Research on Reducing Gasoline Consumption and Pursuing Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Electric vehicle with zero-emission and no pollution, is an ideal clean energy vehicle, which can effectively solve the increasingly serious environmental and energy issues. In this paper, we aim to construct a model to make better plans for the transition of gasoline and diesel vehicles to electric vehicles. We choose South Korea as an example for research and analysis in great detail. According to the model in task one, the optimal number of charging stations is 1.46 million, and the key factor affecting the plan development is geographical distribution. Then by establishing economic model of charging station, the result is that the key factors affecting the charging station plan are investment cycle cost and ease of use. Finally using the economic model, we can get the timetable: from 10%, respectively requiring 5 years.

Author Keywords: electric vehicle, quantitative mathematical, economic model

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Teaching Assistant Software for Relation Normalization Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In database course, relation normalization theory is an important part. In order to help students to better master the relevant schema decomposition algorithms in relation normalization theory, a teaching assistant software for relation normalization theory has been developed, this paper describes the design and implement of the teaching assistant software, practice shows that the software has a good effect in promoting students' understanding the schema decomposition algorithms.

Author Keywords: relationship normalization theory, teaching assistant software, schema decomposition algorithms

articleTitle: Extraction of Factors Related to Transportations and Destinations by Decision Trees for Personal Whereabouts Modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: It has become possible to record the data of a visited place automatically, using a smartphone's GPS. The smartphone can visualize where a user visits and present the traveling route. In this study, we propose a personal whereabouts model for living pattern analysis, utilizing the smartphone's GPS. The proposed model aims to extract personal living patterns effectively. To this propose, it is important to analyze those factors related to location and environment. A decision tree based method is used to extract these factors for the location-based personal data analysis. We finally discuss the experiment design and our observations based on personal data collected from mobile environments.

Author Keywords: Personal Whereabouts Model, Decision Trees, Location-Based Data Analysis

articleTitle: Teaching Research on Undergraduate Computer Graphics Course Based on "Professional Skill Driven"
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the teaching and research practice of computer graphics for many years, the author analyzes the course characteristics, knowledge structure and some problems in the teaching process of computer graphics. Aiming at these problems, this paper puts forward the teaching mode of computer graphics driven by professional skills. The role of basic graphics system and intelligent robot application graphics software in the teaching mode is emphatically analyzed. Through the optimization and decomposition of teaching content, the adjustment of teaching process and the reform of practical teaching, students can not only grasp the theoretical knowledge comprehensively, but also possess design and development capabilities about graphics systems and related application software, and at last possess the good professional skills.

articleTitle: The Exploration of Augmented Reality Technology Applied in Colleges' Experimental Teaching
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The Augmented reality technology is a new informational teaching method. Virtual information can be superimposed on the real environment to form an interactive three-dimensional image by computing, which realized the combination of virtual situations and real environments. This paper described the concept and characteristics of augmented reality technology, analyzed the feasibility of using this technology on experimental teaching in colleges, proposed the way to achieve augmented reality teaching, and investigated on how to improve the teaching effect by using augmented reality.

Author Keywords: colleges, augmented reality, AR, experimental teaching, teaching effect

articleTitle: The Application of TCM Five-Pattern Personality and Constitution Identification System in Population Health Management of Elderly People in Community
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: China's current community health management for the elderly mainly follows the western model of Population Health Management (PHM), lacking of localized theories and methods. Although great achievements have been made in this field in recent decades, adaptation problems and some unhealthy tendencies have also been encountered in practice in China. By introducing and applying TCM Five-pattern personality assessment and TCM constitution identification system in the health management of the elderly in the community, it will be beneficial to carry out the overall view of TCM and the idea that prevention is better than treatment in this field. As a beneficial supplement, it can improve the adaptability of western model of PHM in China, enrich the content of community health management service for the elderly and overcome the bad tendency in practice. The aim is to provide personalized, differentiated, preventive and psychosomatic health management service plans for the elderly in the community.

articleTitle: Using Imbalanced Learning: A Case Study in Refractive Surgery Outcome Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the refractive surgery, the surgeon and patient will evaluate the surgery outcomes. The surgeon performs the prediction with patient's biology features, surgery parameters, theoretical formulas and hypotheses. This prediction could roughly estimate the surgery outcomes. By the popularity of refractive surgery, the clinical histories are enough to implement the surgery outcomes prediction with statistical and machine learning methods, including regression, support vector machine and neural networks. However, as the imbalanced data distribution, these data-driven methods still have drawbacks, including poor accuracy, high data size request and limited interpretability in minority class. This study introduces an over-sampling approach to improve these situation in the surgery outcome prediction. The approach over-samples the minority class to achieve better performance and accuracy. Through the experiment, it is obtained much more accurate results than the imbalanced dataset. In addition, this approach solves the result interpretability issue and the small data size issue in medical cases.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Environmental Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of large data volume, high precision of data processing, unfixed research factors of data prediction model, low applicability of model and complicated prediction data types in big data environment, an object-oriented artificial intelligence prediction model is proposed. The environmental model was established by the research object, the environmental component factors were predicted, the correlation index between the component factors was analyzed, and finally the correlation index was used to determine whether the factor was the model component condition. The comparison between single model and multi-model prediction results shows that a single model can make predictions, but there are errors. The multi-model prediction results show the deficiencies in error processing. Finally, the analysis of environmental data proves the correlation of the existence of correlation factors. The research verifies the feasibility of establishing an environment-oriented prediction model and provides some development ideas for the intelligent model.

articleTitle: Diabetes and Telehealth in China: Diagnosis, Treatment and Intervention
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: There is currently a wide disparity between rural and urban regions in China in terms of the quality and accessibility of healthcare. The most recent 2014 Government Directive singled out telemedicine as a possible solution. Coupled with the vast proliferation of smart phones among China's population there is some degree of optimism that rural communities (and by default urban communities) will start to obtain improved access to healthcare. This contribution provides an overview of the tele-medicine, tele-consultation and mHealth, initiatives currently being applied in the area of Diabetes diagnoses, treatment and intervention, within China.

articleTitle: E-Learning Pedagogical Strategy: Present and Trends in Scientific Research
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: E-learning is the use of Internet technologies to enhance knowledge and performance, which is a hot topic that comes along with the fast development of information technology. Pedagogical strategy is one of the key elements for e-learning products or services. This paper aims to explore the research of e-learning pedagogical strategy with the visualization software named CiteSpace and Excel for enriching related theoretical research and optimizing practices. By mining a database, a network of co-words of e-learning strategies by bibliometric search from 1986 to 2018 is drawn. The study identifies the current status, and discusses how to organize and assess e-learning. Tutoring system, ubiquitous learning, web 2.0 and social networking are the emerging research fronts. The hotspots detected are interactive learning tool and collaborative approach. The study concludes that two features of e-learning pedagogical strategy are as following: People-oriented learning promotes the customized and diverse e-learning products; How to evaluate e-learning should consider context, input, process and product under the cross - discipline background.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Absorption Ratio of iBEAM® Evo Couchtop EP and Effect on Build-Up Region Doses in VMAT by CERR
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As therapies continue to improve tumor control, the importance of reducing late and chronic effects of radiotherapy becomes increasingly imperative to maximize patients’ quality of life. A potential side effect of radiation therapy is a skin reaction, such as erythema, desquamation or necrosis. Such skin reactions can affect the patient’s quality of life negatively. Evaluation the impact of the iBEAM® evo carbon fiber couchtop EP on VMAT delivering accurace were performed with CERR (a Matlab based graphical user interface for radio-therapy applications) in terms of dose volume histograms, depth dose curves and 3D-γ tests with and without couch model included is presented to improved delivery accuracy for radiation therapy and the influence on surface dose distribu-tions. It is our hope that this contribution will lead to improved delivery accuracy for radiation therapy and ultimately to taking more notice on the skin dose of the patient from the couch absorption.

articleTitle: Some Methods to Prove that Strictly Diagonally Dominant Matrices are Nonsingular Matrices
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Strictly diagonally (strongly) dominant matrix is an important research content in numerical algebra and matrix theory. In this paper, the linear equation theory, determinant and matrix eigenvalue theory are discussed. It is proved that strictly diagonally dominant matrices are nonsingular matrices.

articleTitle: Membrane Protein Type Prediction for High-Dimensional Imbalanced Datasets
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research on membrane protein type prediction is of great significance, because the type of membrane protein is exceedingly related to its function. In this paper, a new method is proposed for prediction of membrane protein types. Firstly, two kinds of feature extraction methods, PseAAC and PsePSSM, are used to extract the information from the membrane protein samples. Secondly, feature selection based on random forest is used to eliminate redundant features and reduce the computational complexity. The problem of imbalanced dataset was solved by using the resampling technique which combine SMOTE and Tomek Link. Finally, an experimental comparative study was performed on the membrane protein dataset. The results show that this method can effectively improve the accuracy of membrane protein prediction.

articleTitle: The Practice of the Flipped Classroom Mode in the Information System Security Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Flipped classroom, known as a new teaching concept and mode, can be applied to the information system security education, which can enhance the attractiveness and participatory of it. By turning the teaching centered class into a learning centered one, with a pursuit of the interaction between form and content, as well as the reform of assessment methods, teaching activities of political and ideological education will be transformed, students can turn form the passively recipients into initiative researchers, and the spoon-feeding teaching activities can be more interactive too

Author Keywords: flipped classroom, teaching mode, information system security education

articleTitle: Yiqi Jianpi Huaji Formula (YJHF) Induced Apoptosis of Gastric Cancer BGC-823 Cells Via NF-κB Signaling Pathway
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: To explore the effect of Yiqi Jianpi Huaji Formula (YJHF) on the proliferation and apoptosis of gastric cancer BGC-823 cells and its possible mechanisms. Method: BGC-823 cells were treated with the YJHF water extract (30, 60, 90, 120 and 150 μg/mL) for 24 h, the proliferation of cells was detected by MTT assay, the apoptosis rate of cells was detected by flow cytometer, and the expression levels of caspase 3, Bcl-2 and NF-κB signaling pathway related proteins were detected by qPCR and Western blot respectively. Results: YJHF with a concentration of 30-120 μg/mL could inhibit the proliferation of BGC-823 cells in a dose-dependent manner. In addition, 90, 120 and 150 μg/mL YJHF induced apoptosis of BGC-823 cells in a dose-dependent manner. The expression levels of caspase 3, Bcl-2, NF-κB, IKKα, IKBα and p-IKBα protein were down-regulated in BGC-823 cells treated with 120 and 150 μg/mL YJHF. As well as, NF-κB and IKBα mRNA expression levels were down-regulated. Conclusion: YJHF can inhibit the proliferation and induce apoptosis of gastric cancer cells, which may be related to the NF-κB signaling pathway.

articleTitle: A Case Report of Granulomatous Polyangiitis
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Granulomatous polyangiitis (GPA), previously known as Wegener's granulomatosis, is the most common form of life-threatening vasculitis. Although its exact pathogenesis is not known, GPA is considered to be its own due to the presence of anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies with cytoplasmic staining pattern (c-ANCA) expressed in activated neutrophils. Widespread complex of immune diseases. GPA mainly affects the upper and lower respiratory tracts and kidneys, but it can also cause damage to multiple organ systems. The classic clinical triad of the so-called GPA includes sinusitis, pneumonia and glomerulonephritis. GPA patients have a high risk of death and can cause sudden death. Therefore, early diagnosis and timely treatment are very important. This article aims to improve the understanding of Wegener's granulomatosis in the case of a patient with Wegener granulomatosis and to improve patient prognosis through close interdisciplinary collaboration[1,2].

articleTitle: A Novel C++ Teaching Method Based on Game Mode and ACM/ICPC
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Interest is the best teacher. Teaching practice proves that the role of game teaching lies in that it not only effectively imparts knowledge, but also cultivates students' non-intellectual qualities. Given some problems of the traditional C++ teaching, in this paper, we have proposed a novel C++ teaching method based on the game mode and the ACM/ICPC. Some principles and characteristics of the exercises for the C++ course are presented. Also, some merits and features of our reform method are analyzed in detail. Our proposed reform method significantly improves both the teaching quality and the teaching level. Also, the method is highly praised and generally welcomed by the students and it is a good example on reform and exploration of C++ teaching. Therefore, applying the idea presented in this paper to the C++ teaching conforms to the purpose of this exploratory experimental project, which not only improves the enthusiasm and the hands-on ability of the students, but also cultivates their innovative abilities.

articleTitle: Affecting Factors of KAP of Blood Donation in College Students from Different Types of Colleges
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective This paper analyzes the status of Knowledge-attitude-practice of blood donation of college students in different types in Xi'an, and provides scientific basis for improving the level of blood donation of college students and promoting blood donation rate of college students. Method Through the review of literature, expert consultation and other methods to filter 13 evaluation index of college students on blood donation, and use the Weighted Rank and Ratio Method to evaluate the Knowledge-attitude-practice of blood donation in the medical college, engineering colleges, science colleges, sports colleges and liberal arts colleges in Xi’an. Results The knowledge of blood donation policy (W=0.133), influence of family and friends (W=0.117), the positive attitude of blood donation (W=0.109) are the main factors affecting the blood donation of college students. The blood donation of KAP evaluation of medical college students is the best (WRSR^= 0.048). The knowledge index(WRSR=0.74)，attitude index（WRSR=0.30）and behavioral index score of sports college students are the lowest, and the comprehensive evaluation is also at the lowest level. Conclusion The evaluation of knowledge-attitude-practice of blood donation of Medical college students was the best in all types college, It is an effective measure to promote the development of blood donation in our country by making reference to the blood donation model of medical college students, and to carry out relevant knowledge propaganda and education for different types of college students.

articleTitle: Study on the Treatment of Pelvic Organ Prolapse with Combination of Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Purpose: to explore the clinical effect of integrated traditional Chinese and western medicine in the treatment of pelvic organ prolapse. Method: this study first needs to select the object of study, so the subjects selected are all patients diagnosed as pelvic organ prolapse. The total number of patients in this study is 56. The selected time range for all patients was from June 2017 to June 2018, there were two groups of patients in the 56 patients, the first group was the observation group, the second group was the control group, the two groups had the same number of patients, 28 cases. Only Western medicine treatment was used in the control group, and integrated traditional Chinese and western medicine treatment in the observation group, compared the two groups of patients' effective rate, recurrence rate and whether there is mesh erosion, thickening and tenderness of the broken end. Result: it was proved that the effective rate of treatment in the observation group was higher than that in the control group, and the recurrence rate, the net erosion and the thickening and tenderness of the broken end were also superior to those in the control group, and the difference between the two groups was obvious. Conclusion: the effective rate of clinical treatment of pelvic organ prolapse patients can be effectively improved by combined traditional Chinese and western medicine, which is worthy of further research and development.

Author Keywords: combined treatment of traditional Chinese medicine and western medicine

articleTitle: Acupuncture Combined with Musical Therapy in the Treatment of Post-Stroke Depression: A Case Report
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Rationale: The clinical treatment of mental symptoms of post-stroke depression (PSD) mainly focuses on western medicines which lead to great pain to patients due to unavoidable side effects. In this study, simultaneous treatment of both body and mind consisting of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) acupuncture combined with musical therapy was conducted to a patient with PSD, with satisfactory clinical efficacy obtained. Patient concerns: The patient was a 53-year old male who suddenly developed weakness of limbs on right side 1 month ago and was diagnosed with cerebral infarction by cranial CT. After treatment in local hospital, he still had inarticulateness and weakness of limbs on right side, complicated with depression symptoms marked by low spirit and pessimism, etc. Diagnosis: The patient in this study was diagnosed by comprehensive assessment methods consisting of biological indicator detection, behavioral indicator detection and imageological detection. Interventions: Simultaneous treatment of both body and mind consisting of TCM acupuncture combined with musical therapy was conducted. Outcomes: After treatment, patient's symptoms, nerve function and activities of daily living (ADL) were improved significantly, Hamilton (HAMD) Depression Scale (17 items) score was reduced, and levels of biological indicators interleukin (IL)-6, tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (Hs-CRP) and Homocysteine (Hcy) were reduced and improved significantly. Lessons: Acupuncture combined with musical therapy had significant clinical efficacy in the treatment of PSD and deserved to be further studied. Abbreviations: PSD: post-stroke depression; TCM: traditional Chinese medicine; ADL: activities of daily living; HAMD: Hamilton; IL-6: interleukin-6; TNF-α: tumor necrosis factor-α; Hs-CRP: high-sensitivity C-reactive protein; Hcy: Homocysteine

Author Keywords: stroke, post-stroke depression, acupuncture, five-element music, musical therapy

articleTitle: Model Checking The Robot Control System for Live Maintenance of Substation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 9th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: For the purpose of improving the low efficiency of substation control system, the design of innovative robot control system for live maintenance has become a necessity. The paper gives a detailed explanation for the structure of this system from two different angles. Because of the demand of flexible control and the incidence of certain unstable factors, the reliability of performance of the system becomes quite significant. Therefore, this paper applies PRISM to implements probabilistic model checking for the system to decrease risks. Besides, the experimental results are expected to provide suggestions on how to improve the development of robot control system for maintenance. Based on result of multiple experiments, it is recommended to reduce failure rate of single module. Furthermore, for the planning modules, it will improve reliability of robot control system apparently from changing failure rate of once a month to three month. Therefore, improvement of planning module is essential for reducing failure rate of planning module. Safety modules are also important for robot control system although experiment shows that it is difficult to distinguish effect of safety module. Advanced safety module will improve performance of robot control system.

Author Keywords: Robot control system, Maintenance, Model checking, PRISM, (Continous-Time Markov Chain) CTMC
